QF.id: VB Concept and Role of Mutual Fund_11

question.text: What does "diversification" mean in the context of mutual funds?

answer.text: Spreading investments across many securities to reduce risk
Investing all money in one high-performing stock

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, diversification means proportionate exposure to a range of securities. Diversification helps reduce investment risk by spreading capital across many holdings rather than concentrating on one. The Trap: Investing all money in one stock is the opposite of diversification, concentrating risk. Holding only cash or only government bonds is not diversification either. Note: The workbook also supports investing through mutual funds to access equities, bonds, money market instruments and other securities within a single vehicle.
